messages:
maya: Escalation from AM — BrightHealth (private VPC) reports that the Console shows NO metrics (RPS / p95 / errors) for their tenant since ~2026-11-02 04:30 UTC. They can call the API successfully and our request logs contain entries, but the dashboard charts are empty. Repro steps included below. Can SRE/infra take a look?

aj: Can you paste a sample request + any proxy/sidecar logs and the tenant header name they send?

maya: They use header "X-Tenant-ID". Sample curl I used:
```
curl -v -H "X-Tenant-ID: bh-789" https://private-api.br-1.redwood.local/v1/usage
```
Proxy logs around 04:31 (filtered):
```
[2026-11-02T04:31:12Z] src=10.10.5.12: GET /v1/usage HEADERS: {"X-Tenant-ID":"bh-789", "authorization":"redacted"}
[2026-11-02T04:31:12Z] forward -> upstream /v1/usage HEADERS: {"authorization":"redacted"}   <-- X-Tenant-ID missing
```

aj: Huh. Looks like something in the gateway is stripping the tenant header. Any recent ingress changes?

liam: I pushed the gateway rewrite last week (ingress v1.4.3) to standardize health checks. I can see an envoy lua filter added in that roll:
```
http_filters:
- name: envoy.filters.http.lua
  typed_config:
    inline_code: |
      function envoy_on_request(request_handle)
        -- normalize internal health pings
        request_handle:headers():remove("x-tenant-id")
      end
```
That was meant to only run for internal health endpoints but the route matcher was too broad. This explains why forwarded requests lose X-Tenant-ID.

aj: Confirmed root cause. Proposed minimal patch: only remove tenant header when header "x-health-check" == "1". Patch snippet:
```
local h = request_handle:headers()
if h:get("x-health-check") == "1" then
  h:remove("x-tenant-id")
end
```
liam: I'll cut v1.4.4 with that guard and roll a 5% canary to ingress immediately. @deploy-bot can you run canary?

deploy-bot: Starting canary for ingress-gateway v1.4.4 -> 5% traffic. Deploy ID: deploy-7890. Monitoring health and header-presence metric.

edge-proxy-bot: Canary started. First 1000 requests OK. Header-presence metric shows X-Tenant-ID on 5% target cluster.

nina: For analytics/backfill — we can rehydrate dashboard metrics from raw request logs once the header is preserved. Time window to backfill: 2026-11-02T04:30:00Z -> 2026-11-02T10:00:00Z. Backfill job queued, ETA ~2h after canary promoted to stable, then ~1h for dashboards to refresh.

maya: Customer update I plan to send: "We identified a gateway rewrite that accidentally removed your X-Tenant-ID for routed requests; a guarded fix is deploying now as a canary and we'll backfill metrics for the missing window once stable. ETA ~3–4 hours. We'll confirm when dashboards have data." :thumbsup:

aj: I'll add a temporary alert to paging: if X-Tenant-ID ratio < 99% over 5m for any private-vpc cluster. Also adding a unit test covering the lua filter for route metadata.

liam: Canary healthy at 5% for 12m, promoting to 50% now. No header loss observed on canary.

edge-proxy-bot: Promotion complete -> 50%. No regressions reported.

maya: Thanks all. I'll post a follow-up once backfill completes and then close the ticket. :eyes:
